motion.name: ease-out

components.name: Primary Button (Ozone)
components.description: Primary action button using ozone color
components.css: .btn--ozone { background: var(--ozone); color: #fff; box-shadow: var(--shadow-1); } .btn--ozone:hover { background: var(--ozone-deep); transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-2); }

components.name: Primary Button (Plasma)
components.description: Primary action button using plasma color
components.css: .btn--plasma { background: var(--plasma); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: var(--shadow-1); } .btn--plasma:hover { background: var(--plasma-deep); color: #fff; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-2); }

components.name: Primary Button (Ink)
components.description: Primary action button using ink color
components.html: <button class="btn btn--ink btn--lg" type="submit">Solicitar mi cita</button>
components.css: .btn--ink { background: var(--ink); color: var(--bone); box-shadow: var(--shadow-1); } .btn--ink:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-2); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .btn--ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--ink); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.6px var(--ink); } .btn--ghost:hover { background: var(--ink); color: var(--bone); transform: translateY(-2px); }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.css: .nav__links a:not(.nav__cta) { color: var(--ink-soft); font-weight: 500; position: relative; padding: .3rem 0; } .nav__links a:not(.nav__cta)::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: -2px; width: 100%; height: 2px; background: var(--ozone); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform .25s var(--ease); } .nav__links a:not(.nav__cta):hover { color: var(--ink); } .nav__links a:not(.nav__cta):hover::after { transform: scaleX(1); }

components.name: Form Input
components.css: .field input, .field select, .field textarea { font-family: inherit; font-size: 1rem; color: var(--ink); padding: .8rem 1rem; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); border: 1.5px solid var(--bone-3); background: var(--bone); transition: border-color .2s, box-shadow .2s; width: 100%; } .field input:focus, .field select:focus, .field textarea:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--ozone); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(14,156,134,.18); }

components.name: Form Textarea
components.css: .field textarea { resize: vertical; font-family: inherit; font-size: 1rem; color: var(--ink); padding: .8rem 1rem; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); border: 1.5px solid var(--bone-3); background: var(--bone); transition: border-color .2s, box-shadow .2s; width: 100%; } .field textarea:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--ozone); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(14,156,134,.18); }

components.html: <select id="therapy" name="therapy"><option value="ozono">Ozonoterapia</option><option value="prp">Plasma rico en plaquetas (PRP)</option><option value="otra">Aún no lo sé</option></select>
components.css: .field select { font-family: inherit; font-size: 1rem; color: var(--ink); padding: .8rem 1rem; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); border: 1.5px solid var(--bone-3); background: var(--bone); transition: border-color .2s, box-shadow .2s; width: 100%; } .field select:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--ozone); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(14,156,134,.18); }

components.name: Hero Section
components.description: Main hero section with therapy toggle and call to action
components.html:
Curamos con ciencia, tratamos con calidez.

Clínica de salud integral con terapias innovadoras —ozonoterapia y plasma rico en plaquetas— entregadas con empatía, respeto y cercanía humana.

Agenda tu citaConoce las terapias
  • Atención integral y accesible
  • Terapias regenerativas especializadas
  • Trato humano, sin prisa
Ozonoterapia·Plasma rico en plaquetas·Valoración personalizada·Seguimiento cercano·Calidez humana·
components.css: .hero { padding-top: clamp(3rem, 6vw, 5rem); position: relative; background: var(--ink); color: var(--bone); } .hero__grid { max-width: var(--maxw); margin: 0 auto; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.05fr 0.95fr; gap: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 4.5rem); align-items: center; } .hero__title { font-size: clamp(2.6rem, 1.6rem + 4.2vw, 4.6rem); color: #fff; } .hero__title .hl { color: #83c352; } .hero__lede { margin-top: 1.4rem; max-width: 46ch; color: var(--bone-soft); font-size: 1.15rem; } .therapy { margin-top: 2rem; display: inline-flex; gap: .4rem; padding: .35rem; background: var(--bone-2); border-radius: 999px; } .therapy__opt { border: 0; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit; font-weight: 600; font-size: .98rem; padding: .7rem 1.2rem; border-radius: 999px; color: var(--ink-soft); transition: color .2s, background .25s var(--ease), box-shadow .25s; } .therapy__opt.is-active { background: #fff; color: var(--ink); box-shadow: var(--shadow-1); } .therapy__desc { margin-top: 1rem; min-height: 3.2em; color: var(--bone-soft); max-width: 44ch; transition: opacity .3s var(--ease); } .hero__actions { margin-top: 1.8rem; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .9rem; } .hero__visual { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 1.5rem; } .orb { position: relative; width: min(100%, 420px); aspect-ratio: 1; } .orb::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 8%; background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 45%, rgba(14,156,134,.16), transparent 68%); border-radius: 50%; filter: blur(4px); } .orb__svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: visible; } .orb__glow { animation: breathe 6s var(--ease) infinite; transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: center; } .orb__core { animation: pulse 3.4s var(--ease) infinite; transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: center; } .orb__orbit { animation: spin 26s linear infinite; transform-box: view-box; transform-origin: 200px 200px; } .orb__node { transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: center; animation: twinkle 4s ease-in-out infinite; } .orb__node--b { animation-delay: 1.2s; } .orb__pulse { stroke-dasharray: 520; stroke-dashoffset: 520; animation: flow 5s linear infinite; } .hero__facts { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; gap: .7rem; width: 100%; max-width: 380px; } .hero__facts li { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .7rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--bone-soft); } .hero__facts .dot { width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ozone); flex: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(14,156,134,.18); } .hero__ticker { margin-top: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4rem); border-top: 1px solid rgba(246,240,240,0.18); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(246,240,240,0.18); padding: .9rem 0; display: flex; gap: 1.4rem; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; color: var(--bone-soft); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .01em; font-size: .95rem; } .hero__ticker span:nth-child(even) { color: var(--plasma); }

narrative.overview: MedicSalud's design system combines scientific precision with human warmth. The visual language uses organic orbs and pulse lines to represent oxygen (ozone) and regeneration (plasma) on a warm bone-colored foundation. This creates a distinctive medical aesthetic that avoids cold institutional blues while maintaining professionalism and trust.
keyCharacteristics: Organic visual language with orbital motifs
Dominant ozone accent (#2E7D32) for primary actions
Warm plasma accent (#E0A33B) for secondary actions and warmth
Therapy-toggle retheming that changes visual context
Bricolage Grotesque for display, Hanken Grotesk for body

rules.name: The Ozone Plasma Rule
rules.body: Ozone occupies complete regions (PRP section, footer, nav CTA) while plasma carries the closing action

rules.name: The Therapy Toggle Rule
rules.body: The therapy toggle re-themizes the hero motif and copy using CSS vars --motif-a/--motif-b

dos: Do use the warm bone foundation as the primary background
Do use ozone for primary actions and regions
Do use plasma for warmth and closing actions
Do respect the therapy toggle visual language
Do include purposeful animations that can be reduced
donts: Don't use static medical icon grids
Don't forget to respect motion reduction preferences
